actual setting mismatches the resolved route

requested.rule: User and policy constraints are immutable inputs; a model cannot broaden them.

resolved.rule: Resolution is deterministic over verified evidence; ties use declared cost and latency policy only after risk and quality floors.

actual.rule: Only runtime or provider evidence populates actual values. Missing fields stay UNKNOWN and never inherit requested or resolved values.

transition_policy.escalation_step: one profile at a time unless a deterministic risk floor requires a higher profile
transition_policy.budget_rule: cost and latency may break ties but cannot lower the risk or quality floor
transition_policy.actual_mismatch_rule: fail closed for reproducibility pins and critical work; otherwise record mismatch and require policy disposition
transition_policy.deescalation_rule: only a later task may start lower after current evaluation evidence proves the lower profile meets quality and risk floors
